hardware_pages: 3-49 (Heading #1 on p3 through Heading #90 on p49). p1 = cover, p2 = 'Manufacturers & Finishes' legend. Detector list (5,9,14,16,22,24,27,45-49) is all true positives but misses most set pages: every page 3-49 has sets.
has_mfr_legend: Partial, p2 'Manufacturers & Finishes': lists full manufacturer names with cut-sheet page ranges (e.g. 'Falcon (Pgs 71-149)', 'LCN (Pgs 195-198)', 'Von Duprin (Pgs 227-238)') but NO abbreviation codes, and the components have no mfr column. Finish legend on same page: '626 - Satin chromium plated over nickel', 'C26D - Satin chromium plated over nickel', '689 - Aluminum painted', 'US15 - Satin nickel plated, clear coated'.
has_lookup_codes: Finish legend on p2 only (codes→names), not on the same page as sets.

collision_examples: No mfr column, so no mfr/finish collision; but finish is duplicated inside catalog text ('SC71A Rw/ PA 689' + finish '689', 'TA786 4 1/2" x 4" C26D' + 'C26D'). Brand names occasionally inside catalog ('Horton 4100', 'IVES 69 / 63', 'SALTO Suite Entry Levers By Others').
quirks: This is a supplier's tender hardware SUBMITTAL (Comsense-style 'Heading #/Item #'), not a spec section; 'Page N of 238' footers show it is the first 49 pages of the 238-page Rev_0 file.
Qtys are TOTALS across all doors in the heading (e.g. 204 Standard Hinge for 68 doors; 2571 hinges for 857 elevations).
Long door-item lists (up to ~70 'Item #' lines) can fill whole pages before components appear (p11-12, p33-36).
Many components have empty finish (Threshold CT-45, Card Access By Security Contractor).
Page 3 holds only Heading #1 — sets often start on new pages; frame border around each page.
No set descriptions/titles beyond the door items.
notes_for_extractor: Header detection is trivial ('Heading #N') but sets contain two kinds of rows (door Item rows and component rows) that both start with a number; components follow the door-size line + rule. Mfr will be null for every component; finish must come from the rightmost band, not from codes inside catalog text.
